text:
marco-sales: Urgent - Eva from HarborCorp reports POC demo failing with JSON.parse errors on streaming responses.
eva-client: During the demo the UI shows 'Unexpected end of JSON input' ~6-8s after start and then the SSE connection closes.
marco-sales: timeline: demo start 16:02, error at 16:08, reconnect attempt at 16:12 also failed.
ida-eng: can you attach the raw network body or paste the SSE fragments? need to see if events lack the trailing blank line.
eva-client: pasted short capture in DM, excerpt: `event: data
data: {"id":"x","delta":"Start of sentence"}
data: {"id":"x","delta":" ...and then it}`
ida-eng: second data line looks truncated; missing closing braces and the blank line. Could be the upstream writer closed mid-write.
nina-sre: checking worker logs in the dedicated pool - found `oom-kill` on host pool-b-4 3m before the demo and `write(): Broken pipe` around the demo time.
sam-ml: If the generator process OOMs while emitting tokens it can leave partial SSE payloads. We should add a final error event on abrupt exits so clients don't try to parse incomplete JSON.
leo-sdk: client-side quick fix: buffer incoming SSE `data:` segments until you see `

` then call JSON.parse. Also wrap parse in try/catch and retry once after receiving more data. I'll paste a tiny snippet.
ida-eng: infra mitigation: I'll bump the memory reserve on the pool and roll back a recent experimental runtime. Starting a canary.
deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/pool-memory-bump @1894000030, canary=2 nodes.
nina-sre: also adding a Prometheus counter `sse_truncations_total` and alert if >3 in 10m for a pool.
ida-eng: server-side guard planned: ensure we always write complete JSON objects followed by `

`, and if generator dies emit `{"error":"stream interrupted"}` with proper termination.
eva-client: applying the client buffer workaround for the demo now to keep the demo running. ETA for infra canary?
ida-eng: canary healthy at :55, no truncations in 4 test streams. Full rollout in ~6 minutes.
eva-client: retried after the rollout; demo completed fine, no parse errors. Thanks team.
marco-sales: follow-ups: (1) SDK demo snippet in sales playbook, (2) server guard for event boundaries, (3) metric+alert for truncations, (4) increase pool memory headroom.
leo-sdk: opening PR with snippet and sample try/catch.
marco-sales: closing after Eva confirms POC stability. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
